_note: insight-knowledge-base (stackiq:ins-kb). Knowledge articles are Nextcloud Collectives pages (ADR-022 leaf `collectives`); stackiq keeps no article store. This page searches the Collectives pages the user is a member of through OpenRegister's page search (GET /apps/openregister/api/integrations/collectives/available?search=, which answers { results, total } with title and url per page, and 501 without Collectives, which the kb-search widget shows as its unavailable text). The search matches titles only, so a text widget beside it says so and links to Collectives for full text search. The menu entry is relocated under Applications by src/menu-layout.json (ADR-097: no new top-level entry) and hidden where Collectives is absent; the page's requiresApp says Collectives is needed when reached by URL. The application page's Knowledge articles panel is the md-knowledge widget in src/manifest.json.

content.unavailableFallback: The knowledge base needs the Collectives app. Ask an administrator to install it.

content.text: The search matches the titles of the articles in the collectives you are a member of. To search the text of the articles, use the search in [Collectives](/index.php/apps/collectives/).
